## FakeAudioContext
class FakeAudioContext {
    state: AudioContextState;
    currentTime: number;
    sampleRate: number;
    destination: FakeAudioNode;
    sources: FakeAudioSource[];
    convolvers: FakeAudioConvolver[];
    biquads: FakeAudioBiquad[];
    analysers: FakeAudioAnalyser[];
    mediaSources: FakeAudioMediaSource[];
    onstatechange: (() => void) | null;
    stateCalls: ('suspend' | 'resume')[];
    constructor(opts?: FakeAudioContextOptions);
    advance(seconds: number): void;
    asAudioContext(): AudioContext;
    createGain(): FakeAudioGain;
    createBufferSource(): FakeAudioSource;
    createStereoPanner(): FakeAudioNode & {
        pan: FakeAudioParam;
    };
    createConvolver(): FakeAudioConvolver;
    createBiquadFilter(): FakeAudioBiquad;
    createMediaElementSource(el: FakeAudioMediaElement): FakeAudioMediaSource;
    createAnalyser(): FakeAudioAnalyser;
    createDynamicsCompressor(): FakeAudioNode & {
        threshold: FakeAudioParam;
        knee: FakeAudioParam;
        ratio: FakeAudioParam;
        attack: FakeAudioParam;
        release: FakeAudioParam;
    };
    createBuffer(channels: number, length: number, sampleRate?: number): {
        length: number;
        numberOfChannels: number;
        sampleRate: number;
        duration: number;
        data: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>[];
        copyToChannel(src: Float32Array, ch: number): void;
    };
    resume(): Promise<void>;
    suspend(): Promise<void>;
    close(): Promise<void>;
    get played(): FakeAudioSource[];
}

## FakeDevice  (type-only)
interface FakeDevice {
    readonly device: GPUDevice;
    readonly buffers: FakeBuffer[];
    readonly textures: FakeTexture[];
    readonly bindGroups: FakeBindGroup[];
    readonly writes: {
        buffer: FakeBuffer;
        offset: number;
        bytes: number;
    }[];
    readonly writeData: {
        data: ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView;
        dataOffset: number;
    }[];
    readonly textureWrites: {
        texture: FakeTexture;
        bytesPerRow: number;
        rowsPerImage: number;
        mipLevel: number;
        size: number[];
        data: ArrayBufferView | ArrayBuffer;
    }[];
    readonly passes: FakePass[];
    readonly textureCopies: {
        src: FakeTexture;
        dst: FakeTexture;
        afterPasses: number;
    }[];
    readonly bufferCopies: FakeBufferCopy[];
    readonly querySets: FakeQuerySet[];
    readonly submits: number;
    readonly bundles: FakeBundle[];
    readonly calls: number;
    readonly bundleCalls: number;
    markView(name: string | null): void;
    readonly callsByView: ReadonlyMap<string, number>;
    runPass: ((pass: FakePass) => void) | null;
    readonly errors: string[];
    readonly lost: Promise<GPUDeviceLostInfo>;
    loseDevice(reason?: GPUDeviceLostReason, message?: string): void;
}

class FakeXrSession extends EventTarget implements XRSession {
    readonly mode: XRSessionMode;
    readonly init: XRSessionInit | undefined;

    tracking: boolean;
    ended: boolean;

    get now(): number;
    get pendingFrames(): number;

    step(dtMs?: number): FakeXrFrame;

    removeInputSource(src: FakeXrInputSource): void;

## GpuCounts  (type-only)
interface GpuCounts {
    commands: number;
    draw: number;
    drawIndexed: number;

    setBindGroup: number;
    setVertexBuffer: number;

## PassCommand  (type-only)
type PassCommand = {
    op: 'setPipeline';
    pipeline: unknown;
} | {
    op: 'setBindGroup';
    index: number;
    group: unknown;
    offsets: number[];
} | {
    op: 'draw';
    vertices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
    firstVertex?: number;
} | {
    op: 'drawIndexed';
    indices: number;
    instances: number;
    firstInstance: number;
    firstIndex?: number;
} | {
    op: 'dispatch';
    x: number;
    y: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'drawIndexedIndirect' | 'drawIndirect' | 'dispatchIndirect';
    buffer: unknown;
    offset: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'multiDrawIndexedIndirect';
    buffer: unknown;
    offset: number;
    maxDrawCount: number;
    countBuffer?: unknown;
    countOffset?: number;
}
 | {
    op: 'executeBundles';
    bundles: FakeBundle[];
} | {
    op: 'other';
    name: string;
    args?: number[];
    slot?: number;
    buffer?: unknown;
    offset?: number;
    size?: number;
};
